import json, subprocess, sys, time, os
BASE = {'epoch':7,'node_count':2,'edges':[{'tail':0,'head':1,'capacity':4},{'tail':0,'head':1,'capacity':4}],'commodities':[{'source':0,'target':1,'demand':4,'paths':[[0],[1]],'previous':[16,0]}],'failed_edges':[],'budget':1}
